summary_1line: Garuda advises Galava to seek wealth from King Yayati to fulfill Viswamitra’s impossible fee of 800 rare horses; Yayati offers his daughter instead.

image_candidates.scene_text: Garuda, wings newly restored and powerful, carries the sorrowful sage Galava through the sky in search of the rare horses.
In his court at Pratisthana, King Yayati receives Garuda and the ascetic Galava with ritual water and offerings while listening to their plea.
King Yayati presents his radiant daughter to Galava, declaring she will help accomplish the impossible quest for the eight hundred celestial horses.
